answer: The pigment schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the vine checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 62 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An farming party wanting 34 effective identities must lock that capital for 62 epochs and keep it locked through every bridge audit. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
